bias.zh: 下行趋势 · 反弹受阻于 $36 下方

read.en: MP Materials rose 4.9% on Nov 6 to $35.41, trading $33.82–35.80 on volume about 1.5 times its 20-day average. It is still below the falling 5-day ($36.25), 10-day ($38.19), 30-day ($41.66), 100-day ($48.77) and 200-day ($54.43) averages. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 5, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 3 ($41.55), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: MP Materials 11月6日上涨 4.9%，收于 $35.41，盘中区间 $33.82–35.80，成交量约为 20 日均量的 1.5 倍。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$36.25）、10 日（$38.19）、30 日（$41.66）、100 日（$48.77）和 200 日均线（$54.43）下方。MACD 于 11月5日下穿信号线，位于零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 11月3日起看空（$41.55），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The bounce held above the $31.90 low but stopped short of the $35.56–36.55 zone (Nov 4 low, 5-day, Nov 5 high), which stays resistance. Above that are $37.1–37.8 (Oct 23 and Jul 29 lows) and $38.2–39.0 (10-day, Nov 4 high). Support is $33.8 (Nov 6 low), then $31.9 (52-week low) and $29.6–29.7. A close above $36.55 would target $37–37.8; below $33.8, $31.9.
